content: Implement the M0110 W0113 static vfio-user control-plane slice: generate DMA map/unmap records from the transport manifest, provide a C17 guest encoder and C++20 host server, validate shared-file mappings by generation and epoch, expose the static BAR0/BAR2/BAR4 profile, and preserve the no-reset/no-migration boundary.

CMake dev configure and focused build passed. Schema validator generated 5 definitions and 15 records. Focused CTest passed 7/7: three transport-schema tests, cdev client/worker, vfio-user guest, and vfio-user server.

The first server fixture exposed a result-width mismatch: the inherited completion result is 32 bytes while the BAR profile is 64 bytes. Added the generated 96-byte vfio-user GET_INFO reply instead of changing the inherited completion ABI; bounded the generic reply copier to its result field.
